cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> (no validation errors)
cases.description: Validate a JSON document that fully conforms to the schema when no ExecutionContextCustomizer is supplied. The method should create a default ExecutionContext, run all validators and return an empty set.

cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> (no validation errors)
cases.description: Validate the same valid JSON but with a no‑op customizer. The customizer must not alter the context, so the result should be identical to the previous case.

cases.expected: A non‑empty Set<ValidationMessage> containing at least two messages: one for type mismatch on 'name' and one for type mismatch on 'age'
cases.description: The JSON does not satisfy the schema (wrong types). The method should collect validation messages for each failing validator.

cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> because the customizer removed the required‑field check
cases.description: A customizer that mutates the ExecutionContext to remove the RequiredValidator should allow an otherwise invalid (missing required properties) JSON to pass.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that rootNode must not be null
cases.description: Passing a null JsonNode should be rejected early, typically with an NPE or a dedicated argument‑validation exception.

cases.expected: RuntimeException propagates out of validate method
cases.description: If the customizer itself throws an exception, validate should not swallow it; the exception should bubble up.

cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> (validation completes without infinite recursion)
cases.description: When the schema is marked as a recursive anchor, the method must handle it specially to avoid endless loops. The test verifies that validation terminates and returns the correct result.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that disables the MinimumValidator (e -> e.getConfig().setValidateMin(false))

cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> because the minimum‑value check has been disabled by the customizer, even though the JSON violates the schema's minimum constraint.
cases.description: The schema defines a numeric property "price" with a minimum of 0. The customizer turns off minimum validation, so the negative value should not produce a validation error.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that disables the RequiredValidator (e -> e.getConfig().setValidateRequired(false))

cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> because the required‑field check has been turned off, allowing the missing "price" field to be ignored.
cases.description: The schema marks "price" as required. By disabling the required validator via the customizer, the validation should succeed despite the missing field.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that sets MessageSource locale to French (e -> e.setMessageSource(MessageSource.forLocale(Locale.FRENCH)))

cases.expected: A Set<ValidationMessage> containing a message whose text is in French, e.g., "Le type attendu est string mais la valeur fournie est integer".
cases.description: When the customizer switches the message source to French, validation errors should be reported in French rather than the default English.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that sets MessageSource to a custom bundle with key 'type' mapped to 'Tipo erróneo' (Spanish)

cases.expected: A Set<ValidationMessage> containing a message that includes the Spanish phrase "Tipo erróneo".
cases.description: Custom message source overrides the default wording; the test verifies that the validator uses the supplied MessageSource.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that enables fail‑fast mode (e -> e.getConfig().setFailFast(true))

cases.expected: A Set<ValidationMessage> containing exactly one ValidationMessage (the first error encountered, e.g., type mismatch on "name").
cases.description: When fail‑fast is enabled, validation should stop after the first failure, returning a single message instead of a collection of all errors.

cases.expected: A non‑empty Set<ValidationMessage> containing a type‑mismatch error for the second array element's "id" property.
cases.description: The schema expects an array of objects where "id" is an integer. The second element violates this, so a validation error should be reported.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that disables the MinItemsValidator (e -> e.getConfig().setValidateMinItems(false))

cases.expected: An empty Set<ValidationMessage> because the schema's "minItems":1 constraint is ignored by the customizer.
cases.description: The schema requires at least one item. By disabling the min‑items validator, an empty array should pass validation.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException with message "customizer failure" propagates out of validate method.
cases.description: If the customizer throws an unchecked exception, the validate method must not catch it; the exception should bubble up to the caller.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that sets a null ValidationContext inside the ExecutionContext (e -> e.setValidationContext(null))

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) thrown during validation because the required ValidationContext is missing.
cases.description: Altering the ExecutionContext to an invalid state should cause validation to fail early with a clear exception.

cases.expected: UnsupportedEncodingException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the $ref URI contains an invalid percent‑encoding
cases.description: The schema contains a $ref with a malformed percent‑encoded fragment. When validate() tries to decode the reference it should throw an exception rather than silently ignore the error.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or IOException) stating that the referenced schema could not be found or loaded
cases.description: A $ref that points to a non‑existent schema resource should cause the validation process to abort with a clear exception, because the schema cannot be resolved.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that sets maxDepth to -1 (e -> e.getConfig().setMaxDepth(-1))

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException indicating that maxDepth must be non‑negative
cases.description: The customizer mutates the ExecutionContext configuration to an illegal value (negative maxDepth). Validation should detect this and throw an IllegalArgumentException before processing the JSON.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that disables all validators (e -> e.getConfig().setValidateAll(false))

cases.expected: IllegalStateException (or IllegalArgumentException) because disabling all validation makes the schema unusable
cases.description: If the customizer disables every validator, the schema cannot perform any checks. The implementation should recognise this mis‑configuration and raise an exception.

input.value: ExecutionContextCustomizer that sets MessageSource to null (e -> e.setMessageSource(null))

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) when attempting to format validation messages
cases.description: A null MessageSource prevents localisation of messages. When the validator later tries to retrieve a message, it should throw a clear NPE rather than returning a default or corrupt string.

cases.expected: UnsupportedEncodingException (or IllegalArgumentException) caused by an incomplete percent‑escape in the fragment identifier
cases.description: The $ref fragment contains an incomplete percent‑encoding sequence. The internal call to URLDecoder.decode should raise an exception, which must propagate out of validate().
